title: Drop-in fee
help: The public drop-in page shows this charge type’s current price, which visitors pay at the front desk. To change the price, edit the charge type in the billing catalog.
noneHelp: With no charge type, or an archived one, the page asks visitors to contact the gym about the fee.
previewNone: The drop-in page asks visitors to contact the gym about the fee.
noCharges: Add a charge type in the billing catalog to list a drop-in fee.
conflict: The drop-in fee or the charge type changed elsewhere. The latest values are shown; review your choice and try again.
conflictKept: The charge type or the settings changed elsewhere, so the drop-in fee wasn’t saved. The charge types were reloaded and the saved fee is shown; review your choice and try again.
timeout: The save took too long to answer and may still have gone through. Check the drop-in fee shown before saving again.
archivedChoice: The saved charge type is archived. Choose an active charge type, or no drop-in fee.
missing: That charge type is no longer available. Reload and choose again.
error: The request failed. Please try again.
